description: Row reordering for a priority queue in the Svelte 5 data grid with a drag-handle column. Check several rows and drag the handle of any of them to move the whole selection as a block, and the grid auto-scrolls when the pointer comes within 60 px of the top or bottom edge. It is plain user-land code: dragstart on the handle cell, dragover on rows to compute the insertion index, and drop to mutate the data array.

faq.question: How is the drag handle added?
faq.answer: As a column with a cell snippet rendering the grip; the snippet sets draggable and starts the drag with the row's id. The grid renders the column like any other.

faq.question: How does the block move work?
faq.answer: On drop the handler collects the checked row ids, removes them from the array in order and reinserts them at the computed index, so the selected rows keep their relative order.

faq.question: Is there a managed alternative?
faq.answer: Yes. rowDragManaged gives every row a built-in grip and the grid splices its own data; use this hand-built version when the drag needs to carry a multi-row selection or custom drop rules.
